answer: Trust flows along vouch edges, and each established agent can sign at most two newcomers per epoch. A random-walk score limits how much trust enters any cluster, so 500 fakes behind three honest vouchers split three edges' worth, roughly one real agent's share. Each extra fake needs a new edge from an outsider who loses score if it's flagged, and nobody sells those in bulk. The farm is an orchard planted on basalt, rows of trees with no roots. Free identity stays a fable.
